title: Build SY-N-A-L place-of-places sticky entry surface

do_not_create: a separate sticky product that owns the process
canonical_correction.must_build: A sticky-style digital note entry surface that works like a normal desktop sticky but attaches to SY-N-A-L place context and can optionally activate the existing intent/orchestration layer.
canonical_correction.layer_doctrine: SY-N-A-L is the place of places: browser, app, widgets, applets, extensions, dashboards, threads and desktop surfaces are place nodes. Sticky is one entry surface only.

plain_english_intent: User still gets a real sticky note: coloured note on desktop/browser/widget that can sit dumb until deleted/clicked. If activated, it becomes one of many entry points into the same intent process used by chat, widgets, calendar, forms, extensions and agents.

architecture.place_layer: All entries bind to nearest place_id / place_node. Desktop, browser tab, applet, widget, thread and extension are all places.
architecture.intent_layer: Captured content resolves to a unified work intent only when needed. Sticky does not own the work; it is only a surface.
architecture.orchestration_layer: Existing AGL/Bridge/runtime queues/agents/calendar/task systems act after explicit or policy-allowed activation.
architecture.output_layer: Results return to the same sticky and/or any other relevant surface: widget, calendar, task list, chat, email, dashboard.

user_experience_requirements: User can create a sticky instantly on desktop or browser.
Sticky can be yellow/pink/green/etc and remain visible until user deletes, hides, pins, archives or activates it.
Default mode is dumb/passive: no forced automation, no agent swarm, no conversion to task unless activated or explicitly configured.
Sticky can show a simple action button such as Take Control / Make Useful / Route.
Activation can create or link task/calendar/reminder/agent pod/ordering flow depending on intent.
Same outcome must be reachable from sticky, chat, widget, calendar, form or extension. No sticky-first dogma.
Sticky remains a visual handle/status surface after activation; it does not become the only source of truth.
User can keep a sticky as a personal note forever without it entering execution.

example_flows.default: sits as passive note if not activated
on_activation: route to agent pod for options
return shortlist/status to sticky and widget

phase_1: Inspect existing SY-N-A-L/place/grouping/CC/runtime assets before creating anything new.
Add/extend a sticky entry adapter only where missing.
Bind sticky to current or inferred place_id.
Create passive sticky UI behaviour: create, edit, colour, pin, move, hide, archive/delete depending policy.
Add Take Control action that enqueues a place-bound intent job through existing runtime/PEN/Bridge route.
phase_2: Expose stickies in Command Centre widget by place/status.
Enable browser/extension/app/widget adapters to render same sticky where place context matches.
Add light classification for suggestions without auto-executing.
Add calendar/task agent routing only after activation or allowed automation policy.
phase_3: Agent pod activation: controlled expansion from any entry surface, not sticky-specific.
Portfolio roll-up across places, not notes.
Evidence-bound closure for activated intents only.

required_fields_if_persisted: archived_at not deleted unless user explicitly deletes

acceptance_criteria: A user can create a visible sticky-style note from at least one surface.
The sticky behaves passively until activated.
The sticky is bound to a SY-N-A-L place_id/place context.
Activation routes through existing intent/orchestration path, not a sticky-owned process.
Same intent path can be triggered from non-sticky surfaces.
No standalone sticky product/system/name is introduced.
No orphan signals are created outside a place.
Receipt is written back to GitHub/PEN and, if available, Bridge on completion.
requested_pen_actions: Validate this packet against existing SY-N-A-L place doctrine.
Generate system approval response for user approval.
On approval, execute build via Bridge-safe tools.
If Bridge unavailable, retain in PEN and push from PEN when runner is available.
Return receipt with commit SHA, status, and next action contract.
